title: Keycloak login theme tenant
description: Everything that makes one tenant's login pages look and read differently. The folder name is the theme name chosen in Keycloak.

name.description: Short name, e.g. "DPUK". Available in text as {{name}}.

organisation.description: Full organisation name, e.g. "Dementias Platform UK". Available in text as {{organisation}}.

brandPanelSide.description: Which side of the page the brand panel (logo, image, headline) sits on, on wide screens. The form goes on the other side. On phones the form always comes first. Defaults to "left".

logo.description: Logo shown at the top of the brand panel: a file name in this tenant's folder (e.g. "logo.svg") or a full https:// URL. null for no logo.

logoAlt.description: Text read out by screen readers for the logo. Defaults to the tenant name.

background.description: Brand panel image: a file name in this tenant's folder (e.g. "background.webp") or a full https:// URL. Artwork should sit on the right. About 2560×1440 works well. null for a plain colour.

accent.description: Links, checkboxes and icons. Must be readable as text on white (contrast 4.5:1 or more).

tint.description: Pale background for icons and the 'Signing in to…' label.

base.description: Panel colour shown behind/while loading the image.

messages.description: Text for this tenant. Overrides tenants/_defaults.json and Keycloak's built-in text. Keys are Keycloak message keys (see node_modules/keycloakify/src/login/i18n/messages_defaultSet/en.ts) or this theme's own keys (see tenants/_defaults.json). {{name}} and {{organisation}} are replaced; {0}, {1} are filled in by the page.
